name: Wataru
source:
Star Sign: Cancer
A former member of NEDE who ran away from them because of the cruel treatment he received. He was picked up by Rin and joined her organization.
He's actually a decedent of a Hanki and human couple, but he doesn't actually have any more power than a normal human.
